goal: Read docs/IDEA.md with no history and write docs/BRIEF.md: what this round asks for.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/BRIEF.md has the sections Asked, Deliverable, Done when, Unclear and Not asked
It restates only what docs/IDEA.md says

decisions.what: Treated this round as a change to the existing dashboard web app, not a new build
decisions.why: The idea says to keep everything earlier rounds built and the branding, and to change only what the suggestions ask
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md: 'Keep everything the earlier rounds built and the business's branding; change only what these suggestions ask.'

decisions.what: Listed the 7 numbered suggestions plus the Tests line as the 'Done when' outcomes
decisions.why: They are the observable outcomes the idea names

decisions.what: Put no-AI, offline, no-new-dependency and no-network under Not asked
decisions.why: The idea states these constraints explicitly
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md line 3: 'NO AI, offline, no new dependencies'; line 14: 'no external network requests'

assumptions: 'The existing chart route' and 'the existing fixed chart order' refer to things from earlier rounds that the idea does not describe, so the brief restates them without detail
'Trends off' is read as a team setting, not a product feature, and is listed as unclear
open_questions: Which value and time columns does the line chart use when there are several?
Do the KPIs and exports reflect the active filters?
What score and caption does the table get, and how are degenerate or absent charts handled?
How is a cross-filter removed, and can several categories be selected?
Does clicking a chart on a column with more than 50 distinct values set a filter?
What do the exports' title slide and summary sheet say when no filters are active?
What counts as a phone width, and what hardware is the 1 s target measured on?
